leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a function that accepts a promise and a timeout duration as parameters
Initialize a timeout promise that rejects after the specified duration
Integrate Promise.race() to compete the original promise against the timeout promise
Manipulate the race outcome to return the original promise's value or throw a timeout error
Apply the timeout wrapper to a sample asynchronous operation
Control the timeout behavior by adjusting the duration parameter
Implement error handling to catch and distinguish timeout errors from other promise rejections
lessonTitle: Write a timeout wrapper for promises
